configuration.context_read_stats: reported and asserted within scan_budget for first and continuation pages
configuration.sample_statistics: p50/p95 use nearest-rank; singleton measurements report p50=p95; context continuation timing also reports an aggregate over measured pages
configuration.memory_scope: peak_process_rss_bytes includes worker startup validation; phases execute in separate processes
configuration.event_loop_scope: monitorEventLoopDelay during phase plus a 5 ms timer observation; sample_count zero means no timer tick was observed
configuration.wal_scope: SQLite -wal file size before and after each phase; not checkpointed bytes or disk I/O
configuration.context_continuation_cost: bounded keyset reads pinned to read_seq; each page reports scanned/returned rows and no full snapshot hydration
